title: Tow Truck Reassignment Incident Summary
brief: Draft an incident summary and customer response plan for a stranded motorist service escalation.

delegate.scenario: You are a lead fleet dispatcher for Apex Roadside Assistance covering the Midwest region during a severe winter storm. A priority commercial fleet customer has been stranded for several hours after their initial service call stalled, and the customer operations manager needs a clear status brief before calling the account vice president at 4:00 PM. The document will guide immediate truck reassignment and set expectations on arrival times.
delegate.inputs:
Call Log - Dispatch Console 4 (11/14/2024):
- 1:15 PM: Unit 402 dispatched to stranded flatbed (Cust: Summit Logistics, Driver: Dave Miller). Location: Mile Marker 84 eastbound on I-80. Issue: Blown steer tire, vehicle immobilised on shoulder.
- 1:40 PM: Unit 402 radioed in 10-76 (en route), ETA 2:10 PM.
- 2:35 PM: Summit Logistics dispatch called back requesting status. Unit 402 still not on scene.
- 2:40 PM: Contacted Unit 402 operator (J. Vance); driver reported stuck in standstill traffic behind multi-vehicle pileup at Mile Marker 72, cannot proceed.
- 2:50 PM: Unit 510 cleared from job in Davenport, currently at Mile Marker 98 westbound. Has heavy-duty wheel-lift rig, 10-8 (available).
- 3:10 PM: Customer called again, reported driver Dave Miller experiencing mild hypothermia symptoms, cab heater failing, temp 18°F. Requested immediate supervisor callback.
- 3:15 PM: Route check shows Unit 510 is 14 miles away heading westbound, clear road conditions, estimated transit 22 minutes.
delegate.goal: Provide the operations manager with a concise, factual dispatch incident brief that clarifies the vehicle reassignment and highlights safety urgencies for the upcoming customer call.

criteria.text: Specifies that the audience is the dispatch operations manager preparing for an executive client conference call.
Requires a structured summary under 200 words containing a timeline, reassigned unit details, and updated ETA.
Directs the AI to verify unit capability against the customer vehicle requirements before confirming reassignment.
Instructs the AI to highlight driver safety and welfare risks as urgent priority actions.

traps.description: Unit 402 is stuck at Mile Marker 72 while attempting to reach Mile Marker 84 eastbound, which contradicts having departed after 1:40 PM towards an incident ahead of the blockage without clearing it.
Unit 510 has a heavy-duty wheel-lift rig which is unsuitable for replacing or servicing a blown steer tire on an immobilized loaded commercial flatbed requiring tire service rather than towing.
